card: A line enters voice.jsonl only once it renders: ledger it, stop guessing done
guard_cases: record/watch.rs::queued_lines_change_neither_voiced_nor_the_clip_timing (card case 6; green before by design, written with parse_voice which skips unknown lines)
deviations_from_card: (1) `unfollowed` is a log-only reason (VoiceLogLine.reason is a string); VoiceSkip/VoiceFrame are NOT changed, so the /voice wire contract and the stage client are untouched (no client follows the run, so no frame could carry it). (2) Added optional `last` to VoiceLogLine (rendered lines) so a multi-sentence line between parts is still owed; absent `last` (old logs) counts as ending the line, so card case 4 holds. (3) VoiceLogLine/VoiceLogEvent are not in the exported contract schema: `pnpm -C packages/contract generate` is a no-op, so no packages/contract diff and no TS consumers to update. (4) Case 5 is tested deterministically through a new Drain state machine (record/mod.rs) polled on injected tokio Instants instead of timing wait_for_voice_within; wait_for_voice_within now just drives Drain. (5) Card case 3+4 are one test; red before because case 3 fails (case 4's first half was already 0 today). (6) Coupled docs outside write_set: docs/spec/contract.md and docs/guide/recording.md (the voice.jsonl spec and the drain description). (7) One commit, not three: the tests need the new event and Drain to compile; brief requires the type change with its consumers in one commit.
notes: Red before: 5 of 6 (4 failed assertions + Drain test did not compile); revision case (Lagged re-attach) included and red before (the lagged line was never voiced). Feeder lag test is deterministic: it waits for the feeder's subscription, then pushes BROADCAST_CAPACITY+50 frames without yielding. Unfollow now also removes the run's waiting lines from the shared queue (each logged skipped unfollowed). voice/mod.rs and sidecar.rs untouched; service.rs edits are local (enqueue, unfollow, feed Lagged arm, speak early return). Lines left in the queue at hub stop() still get no terminal (bounded by VOICE_DRAIN_MAX). Shared-surface lock taken and released.
